title: The Pirate Radio's Patron
logline: A rogue broadcast disc jockey operating from a hidden orbital satellite hires a pilot to defend his antenna from corporate jammers, hiding that his scandalous anti-establishment leaks are secretly scripted by station internal affairs to bait dissidents.

roles.description: Celebrated underground radio icon; manic, charismatic, and secretly drawing a monthly retainer from station internal affairs.
Chief station surveillance director who uses the pirate broadcast to bait and identify political agitators.
A naive student courier who delivers authentic whistleblowing files to the DJ, unaware the drops are monitored.
A high-draw electronic warfare cutter fitted with phased-array transmission disruptors.
A jury-rigged solar array and high-gain transmission mast anchored inside a derelict communications relay.
A hidden maintenance crawlspace on the station lower deck where dissident pamphlets are printed.
The station's covert internal security apparatus tasked with suppressing labor agitation.

public_situation: An underground radio station broadcasting bootleg jazz and incendiary corporate leaks draws frantic station jammer interference across {system}.
private_truth: {role:renegade_dj} is an asset of {role:civic_surveillance_bureau}. His show is an orchestrated honey-pot designed to lure idealistic whistleblowers into transmitting unencrypted leaks.

beats.public_change: High-powered noise interference jams civilian comms channels as {role:renegade_dj} broadcasts a call for emergency security escort.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to deliver high-output transmitter vacuum tubes to his broadcast buoy before commercial jammers overpower his signal.
missions.private_fact: His broadcast script for tonight was personally approved by the internal affairs chief to incite a predictable dock strike.

beats.public_change: Station security agents stage a raid on {role:underground_printing_berth}, arresting three pamphlet printers within minutes of a broadcast hint.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to scan the pirate buoy's encrypted telemetry feeds to verify whether the broadcast carries a hidden secondary surveillance carrier wave.
missions.private_fact: Her brother was arrested immediately after transmitting an anonymous corporate wage leak to the DJ's public dropbox.

beats.public_change: {role:mercenary_jammer_skiff} closes in on the buoy, deploying electronic warfare pods to wipe the transmitter's memory cores.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to destroy the mercenary jammer vessel before it fries his primary broadcast array.
missions.private_fact: The jammer was actually hired by a rival station director who has no idea the DJ is an internal affairs asset.

beats.public_change: Internal affairs tactical squads take positions around the dissident safehouse as the DJ prepares his midnight broadcast.

missions.reason: She begs the pilot to rush an unedited recording proving the DJ is a police plant to the buoy's emergency override deck.
missions.private_fact: If the recording airs, the DJ's entire listener network will discover their hero sold them out to secret police.

player_choice.prompt: With the proof that the beloved pirate radio station is a police honeypot, the pilot must decide whether to air the betrayal, let the sting proceed, or extort the surveillance bureau.

options.label: Broadcast the evidence of the police sting to warn the dissidents across the system
Suppress the evidence so internal affairs can arrest the dissident leadership
Sell the proof back to the surveillance chief in exchange for clean criminal records

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the proof of the police sting.
resolutions.summary: The truth airs across {system}. {role:renegade_dj} is disgraced as a police rat, and dissidents vanish into unmapped space before {role:internal_affairs_chief}'s squads arrive.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot hijacked an underground pirate radio buoy, revealing the beloved rebel DJ was a secret police informant.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot suppresses the evidence and lets the sting proceed.
resolutions.summary: Internal affairs arrests fifty underground activists. {role:internal_affairs_chief} secures promotion, while {role:renegade_dj} continues his scripted broadcast for a captive audience.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended a rogue radio satellite, unaware or indifferent that it was a trap capturing political dissidents.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the evidence back to internal affairs.
resolutions.summary: {role:internal_affairs_chief} pays off the pilot and quietly replaces the compromised DJ. The fake dissident radio station remains on the air, fishing for new victims.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot sold proof of a police radio honeypot back to the surveillance bureau for a clean criminal slate.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the mission.
resolutions.summary: Mercenary jammers scorch the buoy's transmitter. The pirate radio goes dark forever, leaving the dissident network shattered and {role:renegade_dj} cutting ties with his handlers.

loose_threads.detail: The high-output broadcast buoy carries internal telemetry transponders registered to the municipal port marshal's communications inventory.
Bail bonds for arrested dissident printers were funded through an offshore escrow agency owned by a senior station security magistrate.

radio_hooks: Station communications authority vows aggressive crackdown on illicit pirate radio broadcasts.
Unregistered audio stream plays vintage jazz intercut with inflammatory corporate leaked files.
Station internal security denies allegations of unlawful signal tracking on private comms bands.

voice_direction.renegade_dj: Manic, hyper-caffeinated, and speaks like a 1950s rock-and-roll radio host. Shifts into chillingly flat bureaucratic monotone when off the air.
voice_direction.internal_affairs_chief: Crisp, cold, and speaks in measured intelligence terminology. Never raises her voice or expresses personal emotion.
voice_direction.dissident_courier: Young, breathless, and intensely earnest. Speaks with passionate idealism that borders on dangerous naivety.
